guard: On a static mesh a hosted run's spawns are bounded by its admission (SPEC 14.8): a helper gets no channel or capability its starter's issued credential did not carry when the run was admitted, a starter that was an operator instrument or held the admin set is exempt and its admission records that, and the record carries the verdict through the store.
why: A workflow run's spawns were exempt from the static spawn bound, so a caller holding run could start a run and spawn a helper the direct door refuses.
The suite runs the manager and core from their built packages, so each mutant is seen through that build and afterRestore rebuilds so the restored source is the artifact again.
R1 exempts every run spawn, R2 writes the exemption for every starter, R3 ignores the recorded exemption, and R4 drops the field when the store's record is read back.

mutations.name: R1 every run spawn is exempt
mutations.expectRed: a run's spawn of a catalog persona wider than its starter is refused, naming the run and the channel
mutations.cell: a run's spawn of a catalog persona wider than its starter is refused, naming the run and the channel

mutations.name: R2 every starter is recorded exempt at admission
mutations.expectRed: a run's spawn of a catalog persona wider than its starter is refused, naming the run and the channel
mutations.cell: a run's spawn of a catalog persona wider than its starter is refused, naming the run and the channel

mutations.name: R3 the recorded exemption is ignored
mutations.expectRed: a run started by a caller holding admin spawns the wider persona
mutations.cell: a run started by a caller holding admin spawns the wider persona

mutations.name: R4 the store's record loses the exemption on read
mutations.expectRed: its admission records the exemption, and the bounded starter's does not
mutations.cell: its admission records the exemption, and the bounded starter's does not
